text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just keep quiet and follow me.
If you're a good girl,
I'll show you the most dazzling view in the world.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You'd better try your hardest not to get left in the dust. Right, puppy?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
